cases.summary: [bug]: unresolved base URL in request endpoints during OpenAPI imports
cases.description:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing issues

### Current behavior

When I import Open API it create request `undefined/api/v2/list` from `/api/v2/list`. so I need manually edit each request. It should use environment variable for base path instead of undefined string.

### Steps to reproduce

1.     Import/Export
2.     Import from OpenAPI
3.     Import from file
4.     Choose file
5.     Import

Use for example Grafana API
[grafana_api-merged.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19110003/grafana_api-merged.json)


### Environment

Production

### Version

Cloud

evidence.eventual_fix_title: fix(common): handle missing host and basePath in OpenAPI URL parsing
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
fix(common): handle missing host and basePath in OpenAPI URL parsing

Closes HFE-783 #4852

This PR addresses the issue where importing the Open API results in requests being generated with an undefined base path, specifically creating requests like undefined/api/v2/list instead of the correct <<baseUrl>>/api/v2/list.
